name: Masaki Akane
source:
"I hate my past."

The three most important things in her life are: [url=https://vndb.org/c3134]Touko-oneechan[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c12869]her brother[/url], and swimming. If she somehow loses them all, what will she do? What can she do?

Hobbies: Swimming, Martial arts (just a little)
Likes: Swimming, being clingy, Touko and Yoshikazu
Basic Behavior: She always wears a bright smile and expresses herself as openly as she can.

[Edited from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=43]MangaGamer[/url]]
